pages.title: Elephant Bird
pages.text: The $(o)Elephant Bird$() ($(o)Aepyornis maximus$()) of Madagascar was among the heaviest birds ever to have lived, standing about 3 metres tall.$(br2)It laid the largest eggs known from any animal, with a volume over 150 times that of a chicken egg, and their shells are still found on the island today.$(br2)It browsed the island's forests and disappeared around 1,000 years ago.
